lead.headline: Hedge funds and banks paid for 14.6% of itemized Texas lobby meals; the top recipient got $10-14K over 15 years
lead.number: Firm-named filers paid 2,114 of 14,448 itemized meals (14.6%, about 22% of range-high dollars); Brad Gilbert got 70 meals worth $10.2K-$14.4K from 11 funds, 2011-26.

June 10, 2014 Brad Gilbert A desire to return to his Lone Star State roots brought Brad Gilbert to the Teacher Retirement System of Texas in 2006, the same year as its well-known CIO, Thomas Britton (Britt) Harris IV . As a member of the public markets team, Gilbert, 38, helps manage the $124 billion, Austin-based pension plan’s $11 billion in hedge fund investments. In late 2011, TRS increased its capacity to invest in hedge funds to 10 percent from 5 percent of the overall portfolio, giving Gilbert and his colleagues plenty to do.
